title: Stop Undefined Stale Probe Flood in Shared Worktree
description: Stop the `undefined.stale` flood: the `[DEBUG] hitcost` probe in build graph inference script-inputs appends to `process.env.PROBE_OUT + ".stale"`, which with PROBE_OUT unset writes a ~30 MB root file `undefined.stale` replicated to all fleet machines and breaking replica verify. Check whether the hitcost investigation (ticket 26/11/10/GET-NORM-PLUGIN-WORKING-END-TO-END, hitcost.md) still needs the probe; remove it if finished, otherwise guard it. Delete the root file, confirm it stays gone, and confirm replica verify no longer reports it as drift.
summary: Removed all finished `[DEBUG] hitcost` probes (including the `PROBE_OUT + ".stale"` writer) from three build library files, deleted root `undefined.stale`; it stayed gone for 7+ minutes and replica verify no longer reports it. Report: undefined-stale-flood.md. Finding for others: the farmhits pass-wide verdict fix (inPassRowsV1/factTooLargeV1) is missing from the shared worktree and pass-verdicts test fails (40 vs 240).
